raw.description:
Bloom is a full-service workplace design consultancy, proudly supporting Poppy & Peonies in their search for a VP of Growth to join their dynamic team. As Talent Advisors, we serve as the bridge between our Bloom Partner and you throughout the recruitment process. At Bloom, we don’t rely on automated tools to sift through applications—every resume is carefully reviewed by a real person to ensure a fair and consistent interview process. If selected, you’ll join Poppy & Peonies directly as a valued member of their team. We’re excited to consider your application! Please note that applications will be accepted throughout the holiday season. Thank you for your patience and interest in this opportunity.

Hi, I’m Natalie Dusome, Founder and CEO of Poppy & Peonies, a fun and energetic brand that believes styles and function should co-exist. We’re passionate about creating practical pieces that help make life a little easier and lighten the load, literally.

Building Poppy & Peonies has been a wild adventure. The journey began when my daughter Poppy was born, and my accessories no longer worked with my new life as a mom; I needed bags with pockets and organization that looked cool and had functionality. I couldn’t find it, so I decided to create it, and in 2015 Poppy & Peonies was born.

We’ve come a long way in five years – from filling orders in my basement to appearing on Dragons’ Den, and now, expanding into new product categories and collaborating with some exciting influencers and brands. I’d be lying if I said it’s been nothing but smooth sailing, but thanks to our incredible community, we’ve never felt more loved and supported!

We believe in our responsibility to care for our environment, and we are passionate about preserving the health and welfare of our planet and the animals that live on it. All of our bags are made from high-quality vegan leather, and our entire product line is vegan, cruelty-free, and PETA-approved. We ship our products plastic-free, and we use a combination of recycled, compostable, and biodegradable materials to mitigate shipping waste. We are constantly looking for new ways to make our products and supply chain more sustainable to reduce our carbon footprint.

About the Role:

We are seeking a strategic, execution-savvy VP of Growth to own the full customer lifecycle, from first touch to retained, repeat customer. This is a senior leadership role responsible for setting the growth agenda for the business and building the team and infrastructure to execute against it.

As VP of Growth, you'll lead a team spanning new customer acquisition, ecommerce and retention, with Director of Retention and Director of Ecommerce reporting directly to you, alongside ownership of TikTok Shop and all new customer acquisition channels. You'll be the senior leader accountable for how the business grows, both in bringing in new customers and in keeping and growing the value of customers once they're in the fold. You'll report to the Co-founder and represent growth as a core pillar in company-wide strategy and investment decisions.

This leader will partner closely with executive leadership to drive growth, inspire cross-functional collaboration, and build a high-performing marketing team.

The Opportunity:

    Growth Strategy & Team Leadership:• Set the overall growth strategy for the business, spanning acquisition, ecommerce, and retention as one connected system rather than siloed functions
    • Directly manage and develop the Director of Retention and Director of Ecommerce, setting goals, coaching performance, and ensuring alignment across their teams
    • Own the growth org structure, headcount planning, and team build-out as the function scales
    • Build a culture of accountability, experimentation, and cross-functional collaboration across the growth organization
    • Represent growth in executive and board-level discussions, bringing a clear point of view on where to invest and why

    New Customer Acquisition:• Own the end-to-end new customer acquisition strategy across all channels, paid, owned, earned, and emerging
    • Own and evolve paid digital marketing strategy across Meta, TikTok, Google, Pinterest, and other paid channels
    • Own and lead relationships with paid media agencies and other external acquisition partners
    • Lead the launch and ongoing scaling of TikTok Shop as an acquisition and commerce channel
    • Build and grow an affiliate program and other emerging acquisition channels (creator partnerships, social commerce, marketplaces)
    • Own key acquisition metrics (CAC, ROAS, MER, new customer growth) and be accountable for acquisition efficiency and scale

    Ecommerce:• Partner closely with and oversee the Director of Ecommerce to ensure the site experience, merchandising, and conversion strategy support both acquisition and retention goals

    • Ensure ecommerce roadmap priorities (site experience, checkout, merchandising, platform investments) are aligned with broader growth strategy
    • Use ecommerce performance data (conversion rate, AOV, site funnel behaviour) to inform acquisition and retention decisions

    Retention & Customer Lifecycle:
    • Partner closely with and oversee the Director of Retention to ensure post-purchase, lifecycle, and loyalty strategies are built to maximize customer LTV
    • Ensure retention strategy is informed by acquisition channel data, connecting who you acquire to how they're retained
    • Own the connective tissue between acquisition and retention, ensuring the business optimizes for lifetime value, not just first-purchase economics
    • Set company-wide LTV and repeat purchase rate goals in partnership with the Director of Retention

What You Bring to the Table

    •15+ years of experience in growth and P&L ownership
    • Proven track record leading full-funnel growth (acquisition through retention) within a direct-to-consumer, retail, fashion, or lifestyle brand
    • Experience managing a team through directors or senior managers, ideally with direct oversight of both acquisition and retention or ecommerce functions
    • Deep expertise across paid social, paid search, media buying, and performance marketing strategy
    • Direct experience launching or scaling TikTok Shop and/or affiliate programs as acquisition channels
    • Strong understanding of ecommerce fundamentals (conversion optimization, merchandising, site experience) and retention/lifecycle strategy (LTV, repeat purchase rate, loyalty, email/SMS)
    • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to connect data across acquisition, ecommerce, and retention into unified business decisions
    • Track record of scaling revenue through data-driven strategy across the full customer lifecycle
    • Experience managing agencies, freelancers, and external partners at a senior level
    • Executive presence and strong communication skills, comfortable representing growth strategy to senior leadership and the board
    • Comfortable balancing high-level strategy with hands-on involvement when a new channel or initiative needs direct leadership to get off the ground
    • Genuine interest in fashion, lifestyle, and community-driven brands

The recruitment process

  • Video screen with Talent Advisor from Bloom
  • Video Interview with Natalie Dusome, Founder + CEO of Poppy & Peonies
  • Second Video Interview with Steph, VP Operations & Natalie, VP Finance
  • Reference checks
  • Offer
    • Applications will be accepted through mid-September. Candidates can expect to hear from us regarding next steps by September 8th, 2026.

Location

  • We’re seeking an exceptional candidate based in the US or Canada who values the flexibility of remote work while embracing the excitement of in-person experiences.
  • There will be occasional domestic and/or international travel for photoshoots, events, and team retreats.

Salary and Total Rewards

  • Annual Salary ranges from $225,000-$275,000
  • Performance bonus
  • 4 weeks of paid vacation per year
  • Health benefits coverage
  • $250 annual period & menstrual budget
  • $1,000 annual allowance towards Poppy & Peonies product
  • $400 home office setup allowance
    • All compensation and benefit amounts are reflected in local currency (CAD/USD where applicable).
    At Bloom, we see conversations around compensation as a continuous discussion. We encourage you to share your desired compensation early in the interview process, but we also understand that as you learn more about the role and the full benefits package, your expectations might evolve. Don't worry - there will be plenty of opportunities throughout the process to revisit and adjust those conversations if needed.

Our Commitment to you.

Like Bloom, Poppy & Peonies is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equitable employment practices and do not discriminate on the basis of race, colour, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status.We’re looking for motivated, compassionate people who are excited to contribute, grow with the team, and support the values that Poppy & Peonies believes in.Poppy & Peonies is committed to developing an inclusive, barrier-free recruitment process and work environment. Please inform us if you require any accommodation, and we will work with you to meet your accessibility needs. Requests for any accessibility-related assistance can be made to

believe transparency matters, especially as technology evolves.

At Bloom, we may leverage AI as a supportive tool when developing role descriptions, interview questions, take home assignments, and interview guides, where appropriate, with the goal of improving clarity, consistency, and accessibility for candidates. However, we do not use AI to source, assess, screen, or interview candidates. Every application is reviewed by a human, every interview is conducted by a human, and all hiring decisions are made by people, not automated systems. Human judgment, care, and accountability are central to how we hire.

About Bloom

Bloom is a full-service workplace design consultancy representing Poppy & Peonies at they build their team. As Talent Advisors, we will be the liaison between our Bloom Partner and yourself during this recruitment process. We do not use fancy tech to search through resumes at Bloom; every resume is reviewed by a human to ensure that we attain a consistent and equitable interview process. You will directly join our client’s team if you are selected as the successful candidate. We look forward to seeing your application!

raw.description:
About the Role

If you've worked with Student Information Systems and are passionate about helping institutions modernize the student experience, The Student First partnership is expanding Blackbaud’s Higher Education strategy and we're looking for a Senior Solutions Consultant with deep Student Information System (SIS) expertise to help shape how colleges and universities evaluate modern SIS, Financial Aid, Student Accounts, payment processing, and connected campus solutions. Together, Blackbaud and Student First will deliver a best-in-class Connected Campus experience that reduces complexity and campus silos, unifying enrollment, financial aid, scholarships, advancement and finance into a single operating model. You'll play a key role in building our SIS practice while helping institutions solve some of their most complex operational challenges. As a Senior Solutions Consultant, you'll combine your Higher Education expertise with consultative problem-solving to help colleges and universities evaluate and modernize the technology that powers the student lifecycle. Working closely with Sales, you'll guide institutions through discovery, validation, and solution evaluation while helping them understand how modern technology, automation, payments, and emerging AI capabilities can support institutional goals and improve student outcomes. You'll be one of our first dedicated SIS specialists, helping shape how we support Higher Education institutions, validate complex solutions, and scale our go-to-market strategy. You'll have the opportunity to influence best practices, enablement, customer experiences, and the future of Higher Education Solutions Consulting at Blackbaud.

What You'll Do

  • Lead discovery conversations with stakeholders across admissions, enrollment, registrar operations, Financial Aid, Student Accounts, IT, and executive leadership.
  • Design and lead validation experiences that help institutions evaluate business, operational, and technical fit.
  • Deliver compelling demonstrations, workshops, and proof scenarios aligned to customer priorities.
  • Advise customers on SIS modernization, process improvement, payment processing, integrations, reporting, and change management.
  • Help customers understand how automation and emerging AI capabilities can support institutional effectiveness.
  • Support RFPs, technical evaluations, proof-of-concept activities, and executive presentations.
  • Partner closely with Student First and internal Blackbaud teams to deliver successful customer outcomes.
  • Create reusable demo experience assets, enablement resources, and best practices that help scale Blackbaud's SIS expertise.

What You’ll Have

  • 5+ years of Higher Education SIS experience.
  • Strong understanding of admissions, enrollment, registration, academic records, and student services.
  • Experience working within Higher Education or supporting Higher Education technology solutions.
  • Strong communication, presentation, and consultative problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to build credibility with both business and technical stakeholders.
  • Willingness to travel up to 25%.
  • Experience with student finance, billing, and payment processes.
  • Experience with SIS platforms such as Banner, Colleague, Workday Student, PeopleSoft, Anthology Student, or Jenzabar.
  • Experience in consulting, implementation, solutions consulting, or sales engineering.
  • Familiarity with AI, automation, and digital transformation initiatives in Higher Education.
  • Familiarity with Blackbaud solutions, including Raiser's Edge NXT, Financial Edge NXT, and Blackbaud Integrated Payments.

Stay up to date on everything Blackbaud, follow us on Linkedin, Twitter, Instagram, Facebook and YouTube ​

Blackbaud powers social impact through purpose‑driven technology and responsible AI. Guided by our Intelligence for Good® vision, we’re building a culture where innovation, trust, and human expertise come together to help organizations make a greater difference in the world.

Blackbaud is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to maintaining a diverse and inclusive work environment. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, physical or mental disability, age, or veteran status or any other basis protected by federal, state, or local law.

The starting base salary and annual proposed commission is $98,400.00 to $127,000.00. Blackbaud may pay more or less based on employee qualifications, market value, sales quota, Company finances, and other operational considerations.

Benefits Include:

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • Remote-flexible workforce

  • Wellness Programs

  • 401(k) program with employer match

  • Flexible paid time off

  • Generous Parental Leave

  • Donations for Doers

  • Pet insurance, legal and identity protection

  • Tuition reimbursement program

raw.description:
Working with us

We provide you with a working environment where personal development and value creation go hand in hand. You will gain access to our learning materials to improve your financial skills which will come in handy during future interviews. You provide extensive coverage of Mergers, Acquisitions, and major corporate transactions and lead the team to excel in research. You will dive into the deal announcement, proxies, earnings calls, and more. You will identify and outline the rationale of both the buyer and seller, underlying trends, market and product opportunities, and key industry consequences of the deals. You will interact and build relationships with like-minded students from across the globe. You will build a strong, performance-oriented team environment and informally coach the incoming analysts. You will help Focus Finance drive international engagement and build the brand. And if you are committed, more challenging projects and positions are in for you.

Your key responsibilities

  • Conduct research and financial reports writing together with the report team, ensuring execution quality and alignment to Focus Finance’s quality standards

  • Liaise with the M&A Global Heads and Leadership Team for strategic and operational division decision-making

  • Participate in the learning schemes and seek to develop your finance knowledge, as well as benefit from practical learning in team and project management

  • Help Focus Finance drive engagement, gain new readership and expand its brand presence at new universities

We carefully recruit all our members to ensure consistency across our branches. We are looking at a number of skills and interests throughout the recruitment process:

  • Undergraduate student specializing in finance, management, economics, engineering, or similar (we welcome applications from all universities across the globe)

  • Knowledge on how to construct valuation models from scratch (3-statement operating model, DCF, trading comps)

  • High industry, business and commercial awareness

  • A strong interest in M&A, capital markets, private equity or corporate development

  • Previous leadership/management experience is a plus but not required

  • Core soft skills – teamwork, adaptability, resilience, international mindset

  • The ability to balance qualitative and quantitative data

You may submit your CV (a cover letter is not required for this position). A member of the Human Capital Management team will screen your application and inform you regarding the next steps.

Do you have questions regarding this job opening? For more information, please contact Rayan Singh (Co-Head of M&A) or the Human Capital Management team via the Contact function on our website (www.focusfinance.org/contact)

Focus Finance provides equal opportunities for all members and applicants for employment. It prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, colour, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression.

We are Focus Finance, a global network of students interested in finance & banking. Our analysts and partners work across 5 report streams (M&A Deals, Industry Trends, Capital Markets, Equity Research and Global M&A Outlook) to deliver high-quality and rich content reports to our readership and institutional partners. We bring together 90+ passionate, motivated and determined students from 35 universities across 12 countries to provide a truly international platform for career development and networking. We are active, self-managed and always looking for new challenges.

Cadastre-se agora mesmo em nossas vagas!

Buscamos um Engenheiro de Dados Senior para atuar em uma arquiteturalakehouse na AWS, na qual o Snowflake e o Data Warehouse principal e

consome tabelas Apache Iceberg armazenadas no S3. O profissional seráreferencia técnica do ecossistema de dados, responsável por projetar,construir e evoluir pipelines robustos e a interoperabilidade entre odata lake e o warehouse, garantindo qualidade, performance, controle decusto e governança das soluções entregues.

Principais responsabilidades:

- Projetar e implementar pipelines de ingestão, transformação edisponibilização de dados em ambiente AWS, escrevendo e mantendotabelas Apache Iceberg no S3.

- Desenvolver jobs de processamento distribuído em Spark (EMR e/ou AWSGlue), incluindo cargas incrementais, upserts (MERGE) ereprocessamentos históricos.

- Garantir a integração entre Snowflake e o lakehouse Iceberg: externalvolumes, catalog integration (Glue Data Catalog), tabelas gerenciadaspelo Snowflake versus externamente gerenciadas e sincronização demetadados.

- Executar e automatizar a manutenção das tabelas Iceberg: compactaçãode arquivos pequenos, expiração de snapshots, remoção de arquivosórfãos, evolução de schema e de particionamento.

- Modelar e otimizar modelos de dados e queries no Snowflake, garantindoperformance e uso eficiente de recursos.

- Monitorar e otimizar custo e performance dos ambientes AWS e Snowflake(dimensionamento de warehouses, clustering, politicas de cache, custo

de leitura no data lake).

- Atuar na definição de boas praticas de engenharia de dados:versionamento em Git, CI/CD, testes de dados, documentação e linhagem.

- Implementar controles de governança e segurança: RBAC, politicas demascaramento e de row access no Snowflake e permissionamento via LakeFormation.

- Diagnosticar e solucionar problemas de performance e disponibilidadeem ambientes de dados críticos.

- Atuar como referencia técnica do time: revisão de código, mentoria deprofissionais menos experientes e registro de decisões de arquitetura.

- Colaborar com times de dados, produto e negocio no levantamento derequisitos e na definição de soluções.


Requisitos obrigatórios:

- Experiencia comprovada de no mínimo 5 anos atuando em ambiente Cloud AWS.

- Experiencia comprovada de no mínimo 3 anos com Snowflake, incluindo modelagem, otimização de queries e gestão de warehouses e custo.

- Experiencia comprovada em produção com Apache Iceberg (desejavel 2 anos ou mais): particionamento, evolução de schema, snapshots e time

travel, MERGE e rotinas de manutenção e compactação.

- Experiencia com Apache Spark em escala (PySpark), incluindo tuning de jobs e diagnostico de skew e shuffle.

- Conhecimento em serviços AWS voltados a dados: S3, Glue (ETL e Data Catalog), EMR, Athena, Lambda e Step Functions.

- Domínio de SQL avançado para consultas complexas e otimização em ambientes de grande volume de dados.

- Experiencia com modelagem de dados e arquiteturas de Data Warehouse, Data Lake e Lakehouse.

- Python aplicado a automação e engenharia de dados.

- Experiencia com orquestração de pipelines (Airflow, Step Functions, dbt ou equivalente).

- Git e cultura de versionamento, testes e code review.

- Inglês técnico para leitura de documentação.

Diferenciais:

- Certificação SnowPro (Core ou Advanced).

- Certificações AWS (Solutions Architect, Data Engineer ou Data Analytics).

- Experiencia com Terraform ou outra ferramenta de Infraestrutura como Código.

- dbt em produção.

- Experiencia com catálogos abertos (Glue Data Catalog, Polaris / Open Catalog, Unity) e cenários multi-engine.

- Experiencia com streaming (Kinesis, Kafka / MSK, Snowpipe Streaming).

- Ferramentas de observabilidade e qualidade de dados (dbt tests, Great

Expectations, Monte Carlo).

Competências comportamentais:

- Autonomia para conduzir entregas técnicas com pouca supervisão.

- Comunicação clara para interagir com áreas de negocio e times multidisciplinares.

- Pensamento analítico e foco em resolução de problemas complexos.

- Postura colaborativa e proatividade na proposição de melhorias técnicas.

Informações adicionais

Who We Are: HelioCampus was founded with the purpose of helping college & university leaders navigate today’s growing pressures. As one of EdTech’s most steadily growing companies, our roots in higher ed ground us in the critical nature of this work.

What We Do:We help our clients navigate today’s high stakes with data and Institutional Performance Management practices. Together with our clients, we chart a path to sustainability by borrowing practices from the most successful businesses.

How We Do It:
We approach our work with a “we’re on it” attitude that the higher ed community has come to know and expect from our team. We’re data geeks to our core, committed to simplifying the toughest challenges and operating with transparency. Our most successful team members are change agents who love a challenge.

How You'll Help:The VP of Client Success will be responsible for leading and managing the client success team to ensure the successful adoption, retention, and expansion of our company's products and services by our clients. You will play a crucial role in building strong relationships with clients, understanding their needs, and working cross-functionally to drive customer satisfaction and long-term success. This position requires a strategic mindset, exceptional leadership skills, and a deep understanding of customer success principles.

What You Will Do:

  • Team Leadership:

    • Lead, mentor, and motivate the client success team, fostering a culture of excellence, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

    • Set clear performance expectations, objectives, and key results (OKRs) for team members, regularly assessing and providing feedback on their performance.

    • Ensure the team is equipped with the necessary tools, resources, and training to deliver outstanding customer experiences.

  • Customer Success Strategy:

    • Develop and implement a comprehensive customer success strategy that drives impact for clients and aligns with the company's overall goals and objectives.

    • Identify opportunities to improve customer satisfaction, retention, and expansion by analyzing customer data, trends, and feedback.

  • Client Relationship Management:

    • Build and maintain strong relationships with key clients, acting as their advocate within the company and ensuring their needs are met.

    • Proactively engage with clients to understand their business objectives, challenges, and opportunities, providing strategic guidance and support.

  • Customer Onboarding and Adoption:

    • Oversee the onboarding process for new clients, ensuring a smooth and efficient transition to using our products and services.

    • Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including sales and product development, to drive product adoption and customer success.

  • Customer Retention and Expansion:

    • Develop and execute initiatives to drive customer retention, reduce churn, and increase customer lifetime value.

    • Identify upsell and cross-sell opportunities within existing accounts, working closely with the sales team to drive revenue growth.

  • Customer Success Metrics and Reporting:

    • Define and track key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness of the client success team and overall customer success efforts.

    • Regularly report on customer success metrics and provide insights and recommendations to senior management.

  • Customer Feedback and Advocacy:

    • Capture customer feedback, testimonials, and case studies to demonstrate the value of our products and services to prospective clients.

    • Collaborate with marketing and sales to leverage customer success stories in promotional materials.

You Will Be a Good Fit For This Role If You Have:

  • Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, or a related field (advanced degree preferred).

  • Proven experience (typically 8+ years) in customer success management, account management, or a related role, with at least 3-5 years in a leadership position.

  • Strong understanding of customer success principles, strategies, and best practices.

  • Excellent communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.

  • Ability to build and maintain relationships with clients at all levels of the organization.

  • Analytical mindset with the ability to leverage data for decision-making.

Nice To Have’s Include:

  • Results-driven with a focus on achieving customer satisfaction and business objectives.

  • Demonstrated experience in driving customer retention and expansion.

  • Strong leadership and team management skills, with a track record of building and developing high-performing teams.

  • Experience in working with cross-functional teams, including sales, marketing, and product development.

  • Familiarity with customer success software and tools is a plus.

A Note on AI in Our Hiring Process:

We are an AI-forward company and champion the smart use of technology. However, our hiring process is designed to evaluate your personal capabilities, critical thinking, and lived experience. Please ensure your resume, application materials, and interview responses are your own and not generated by AI. Show us your raw talent and your genuine experience, that is the person we want to join our team.

Location:

This specific role is primarily remote, with occasional travel to an office or client site. US East Coast working hours are required, and a strong preference is given to candidates who can easily travel to our Chapel Hill, NC or Bethesda, MD offices for occasional in-person work.

Compensation and Benefits:

Flexible work schedule, 18 PTO days on day one with additional PTO per year. Fifteen (15) paid holidays, medical/dental/vision coverage, parental leave, 401K with match, company events, referral bonus, professional development opportunities, home office perks, and two office locations.

What Sets Us Apart:

1. Commitment to Higher Education:We believe that serving higher ed makes the world a better place. This drives our desire to deliver high-quality products and services to help higher education institutions serve their students and communities.

2. Flexibility to Fit Your Life:HelioCampus employees enjoy the autonomy, freedom, and trust of a remote-first working environment. We embrace an “on it” mentality both in and out of the workplace, and employees are supported in pursuing personal and professional passions.

3. A Community of Bright Minds with Big Hearts:HelioCampus hires curious and talented practitioners who bring a diversity of thought and genuine care for one another and our clients to work every day. Our team members are more than a job description and are encouraged to show up as their full and authentic selves.

What We Believe:

HelioCampus is an equal opportunity employer, and all qualified candidates will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

Disclaimer:

The list of responsibilities described above is not comprehensive. Other tasks not mentioned here may be required. Changing business conditions may trigger changes to job responsibilities. This job description is not an employment contract.

Physical Qualifications:

This position requires the following physical qualifications to support a productive remote work environment. We are dedicated to providing reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions of this role. If you require accommodations, please discuss this during the application process.

Vision:Sufficient visual acuity to read documents, view computer screens, and engage in tasks that require attention to detail.

Hearing:Ability to communicate effectively in person (as applicable) and via phone or video conferencing, ensuring clear understanding of verbal instructions.

raw.description:
The Company

Dexcom Corporation (NASDAQ DXCM) is a pioneer and global leader in continuous glucose monitoring (CGM). Dexcom began as a small company with a big dream: To forever change how diabetes is managed. To unlock information and insights that drive better health outcomes. Here we are 25 years later, having pioneered an industry. And we're just getting started. We are broadening our vision beyond diabetes to empower people to take control of health. That means personalized, actionable insights aimed at solving important health challenges. To continue what we've started: Improving human health.

We are driven by thousands of ambitious, passionate people worldwide who are willing to fight like warriors to earn the trust of our customers by listening, serving with integrity, thinking big, and being dependable. We've already changed millions of lives and we're ready to change millions more. Our future ambition is to become a leading consumer health technology company while continuing to develop solutions for serious health conditions. We'll get there by constantly reinventing unique biosensing-technology experiences. Though we've come a long way from our small company days, our dreams are bigger than ever. The opportunity to improve health on a global scale stands before us.

Meet the Team

Dexcom’s Government Affairs team is responsible for advancing legislative, regulatory, and reimbursement policies that support patient access, innovation, and business growth. Working closely with federal, state, and international government affairs professionals, as well as policy, market access, regulatory, and executive leadership teams, the Lead Senior Manager of Federal Government Affairs will help drive Dexcom’s federal advocacy strategy and strengthen the company’s presence in Washington, D.C.

Where You Come In

  • Lead the development and execution of Dexcom’s federal government affairs strategy to support business objectives and expand patient access to CGM technology.
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with Members of Congress, congressional staff, federal agencies, trade associations, and key healthcare stakeholders.
  • Monitor and analyze federal legislative, regulatory, and reimbursement developments affecting medical technology, diabetes care, digital health, and chronic disease management.
  • Develop and implement advocacy strategies related to Medicare, Medicaid, commercial reimbursement, FDA regulation, health technology assessment, and broader healthcare policy issues.
  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Market Access, Regulatory Affairs, Legal, Public Affairs, Corporate Communications, Clinical Affairs, and Commercial teams.
  • Identify and drive opportunities to advance Dexcom priorities through legislation, regulation, appropriations, and federal agency engagement.
  • Represent Dexcom in industry coalitions, trade association workgroups, and external stakeholder meetings.
  • Develop briefing materials, policy analyses, executive talking points, testimony, and strategic recommendations for senior leadership.
  • Support executive engagement with policymakers and government stakeholders, including preparation of meetings and advocacy events.
  • Mentor and provide leadership to members of the Government Affairs team while helping strengthen the department’s long-term capabilities.

What Makes You Successful

  • Deep understanding of the federal legislative and regulatory process.
  • Proven ability to influence public policy outcomes through strategic engagement and coalition building.
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare policy, reimbursement, medical technology, and federal health agencies.
  • Exceptional communication, relationship-building, and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to navigate complex and rapidly evolving policy environments.
  • Strong strategic thinking, project management, and cross-functional leadership capabilities.
  • Demonstrated ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities and competing deadlines.

What You’ll Need

  • Bachelor’s degree required; advanced degree preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in federal government affairs, public policy, congressional offices, federal agencies, trade associations, or related healthcare advocacy roles.
  • Significant experience working on healthcare, medical technology, reimbursement, Medicare, Medicaid, or FDA-related issues.
  • Established network of relationships within Congress, the Administration, trade associations, and healthcare stakeholder organizations.
  • Experience leading complex policy initiatives and advocacy campaigns.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience advocating on behalf of a medical device, biotechnology, digital health, or healthcare company.
  • Understanding of diabetes policy, chronic disease management, and emerging healthcare technologies.
  • Experience managing consultants, coalition partners, and external advocacy resources.
  • Previous people leadership experience.

What you’ll get:

  • A front row seat to life changing CGM technology. Learn about our brave #dexcomwarriors community.
  • A full and comprehensive benefits program.
  • Growth opportunities on a global scale.
  • Access to career development through in-house learning programs and/or qualified tuition reimbursement.
  • An exciting and innovative, industry-leading organization committed to our employees, customers, and the communities we serve.

Travel Required:

  • 15-25%

Experience and Education Requirements:

  • Typically requires a Bachelor’s degree with 13+ years of industry experience

  • 5-8 years of previous people management experience

Remote Workplace:

Your location will be a home office; you are not required to live within commuting distance of your assigned Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km). If you reside within commuting distance of a Dexcom site (typically 75 miles/120km) a hybrid working environment may be available. Ask about our Flex workplace option.

Role Title: Military/Veteran Mental Health Experts

Role Type: Contractor

Location: Remote

micro1 is engaging Mental Health Experts to contribute to a high-impact customer project focused on the advancement of AI technologies in mental health. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

This opportunity is ideal for professionals with substantial experience in providing direct patient care to military personnel or veterans, whether as board-certified psychiatrists (post-residency) or clinical psychologists (PhD completed).

Scope of Work

  1. Review and evaluate mental health materials, case studies, and simulated patient interactions relevant to military and veteran populations.
  2. Provide expert feedback and nuanced analysis to refine AI models' understanding of clinical best practices, diagnostic processes, and therapeutic approaches.
  3. Create, edit, and curate prompts, responses, and scenarios that reflect real-world challenges experienced by military and veteran patients.
  4. Identify domain-specific terminology, cultural nuances, and communication techniques essential for effective mental health support in this population.
  5. Participate in virtual discussions or consultative sessions to align on project goals and share clinical perspectives.
  6. Document findings, recommendations, and potential improvements in a clear, structured, and accessible format.
  7. Ensure all contributions meet high standards for clinical accuracy, relevance, and sensitivity to the unique needs of service members and veterans.

Preferred Qualifications

  1. Medical doctor (psychiatrist) with completed residency, or psychologist with completed PhD.
  2. Demonstrated direct patient care experience with military and/or veteran populations.
  3. Deep familiarity with trauma, PTSD, TBI, adjustment disorders, and other conditions prevalent among service members.
  4. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to translate complex clinical concepts for diverse audiences.
  5. Experience developing or reviewing clinical content, training materials, or assessment tools.
  6. Strong attention to detail, clinical accuracy, and cultural competence.
  7. Adaptability and interest in contributing to technology-driven mental health solutions.
  8. We are prioritizing applicants with proficiency in one or more of these languages: Japanese, French, Tagalog, Malay, Lithuanian, Russian, Georgian, Polish, Marathi, Bengali, Urdu, Vietnamese, Swahili, Mandarin, Cantonese, Indonesian, Turkish, Gujarati, Bulgarian.

raw.excerpt: Eventbrite is disrupting a huge industry in desperate need of a shakeup.
raw.description:
Eventbrite is disrupting a huge industry in desperate need of a shakeup. We're looking for a talented, driven and collaborative Business development manager to be the first point of contact for our sales efforts, generating demand and building a pipeline for our Account executives.

A few examples of your responsibilities

  • Run the B2B sales function. Joining a fast-moving team and helping us scale a world-class sales organization to its next level, you’ll focus on executing and optimizing our sales processes, managing client relationships, and driving measurable results in enterprise sales.
  • Go after high-potential leads. Identify and cold-call on-target businesses to build a portfolio of respected, revenue-driving corporate clients.
  • Learn the industry inside and out. Understand the incentives, pressure points, and decision-makers of your industry so you can build profitable relationships.
  • Work closely with the product. Speak about it with clarity and confidence. Gather feedback from clients and share input to help shape future development.
  • Follow the data. Keep a close eye on performance metrics to gauge impact and zero in on the highest-value opportunities.
  • Stand out at every touchpoint. Deliver outstanding service that builds trust with every client interaction.

What we look for

  • Drive. You’re extremely ambitious in everything you do—and your initiative, effort, and tenacity match the intensity of your ambition. You feel deeply responsible for your work. You hold yourself to a high—and rising—bar.
  • Reasoning ability. Given the necessary knowledge, you can solve complex problems. You think from first principles, and structure your ideas sharply. You resist the influence of biases. You identify and take care of the details that matter.
  • Team spirit. You give generously and without the expectation of receiving in return. You support the best idea, not your idea. You're always happy to get your hands dirty to help your team. You’re reliable, honest, and transparent.
  • Proficiency in English. You read, write, and speak proficiently in English.

What we offer

  • An exceptional opportunity for growth. We go to great lengths to hire individuals of outstanding potential—then, our priority is to put them in the ideal position to thrive. If you’ve got what it takes, you’ll soon be playing an essential role in major projects.
  • Incredibly talented, entrepreneurial teams. You’ll work in small, result-oriented, autonomous teams alongside some of the brightest people in your field.
  • Competitive pay. Typically, we offer individuals with limited experience a base salary of $70,173 to $91,661 in the US, with an additional performance-based variable compensation component. Compensation varies by location and expected impact, and grows rapidly as you gain experience and translate it into greater contributions. For individuals who demonstrate exceptional capability, we may offer compensation that extends beyond the usual ranges to reflect their higher expected impact.

Commitment & contract

Permanent. Full-time.

Location

Fully remote.

The selection process

If you pass our screening, we’ll invite you to a couple of interviews, designed to assess your motivation, ambitions, and how you approach unfamiliar problems. Interviews are a two-way conversation: a chance for us to get to know you, and for you to learn more about the company. So make the most of it—ask questions, dig into the way we work, and hear directly from the people you’re going to meet.

We set the bar high and won't extend an offer until we're convinced we've found the right candidate. This is why a job may stay open for months or be reposted several times.

Studies suggest that women tend not to apply for a job if their CV isn’t a perfect fit. Here, talent takes precedence over experience. So if you like the role and think you could be awesome at it in time, go ahead and apply.

ABOUT EVENTBRITE

At Eventbrite everyone is invited to be their whole self and we cultivate an environment to make sure that is feasible throughout the entirety of an individual's time at Eventbrite. We are committed to providing competitive, valuable and meaningful benefits and experiences for our employees to ensure we meet them where they are in life.

Cultivating a diverse, equitable and inclusive culture where all people are invited and belong is our top priority.

Employees can participate in resource groups and we offer global programming and training throughout the year to support a diverse and inclusive workplace. Read more about our Diversity and Inclusion work for our team, culture, and community.

BENEFITS

We offer comprehensive benefits and a wellness package above and beyond standard medical benefits to support our Britelings’ lifestyle.

Eventbrite's global benefit programs are designed to meet you where you are by offering resources and support for your health, well-being, finances, and family. This includes support in a remote environment, wellness allowance, Carrot family planning benefit, Origin Financial Planning service, and other offerings to ease the mind and body like Modern Health and BriteBreaks (generally the first Friday of every month off).

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

At Eventbrite, we are dedicated to fostering diversity, equity and inclusion. We welcome individuals from all backgrounds, abilities and experiences to apply, and we make employment decisions on the basis of merit. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion or religious creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender reassignment, gender expression, age, marital status, status as a protected veteran, physical or mental disability, medical condition, genetic information or characteristics, or any other legally protected characteristic.

If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during any part of the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

raw.description:
About us

Joining Busuu means being part of one of the top EdTech companies in the world, a multiple award-winner recognised for its innovation and impact in language learning.

Busuu’s vision is to empower people through languages. We are the world’s largest online community for language learning, with 120+ million registered users. We make learning a language easy by combining AI-powered courses with feedback from our global community of native speakers and lesson content designed for real life.

Busuu is part of the global Chegg family. Chegg is the leading student-first connected learning platform and a NYSE listed company.

What does a Freelance Online Portuguese Teacher do at Busuu?

As a Freelance Online Portuguese Teacher at Busuu, you’ll play a key role in helping students learn Portuguese effectively and confidently. On a day-to-day basis, your responsibilities will likely include:

  • Planning, preparing, and teaching online lessons (45 minutes each)for corporate clients.

  • 1:1 Lessons:Deliver private lessons that include both language teaching andpersonalised coaching- conducting needs analyses, assessing levels, creating bespoke learning paths, checking progress during lesson time, and setting clear goals.

What we’re looking for in a Freelance Online Language Teacher:

  • C2 Level of Portuguese

  • Valid teaching certificate such as TEFL/CELTA or related university degrees

  • Experience in online teaching and providing 1:1 coaching or personalised learning support

  • Fluency in additional languages:

    • B1 or above in English

    • Bonus:Speaking more than two languages

  • Comfortable teaching: presentation skills, negotiations, business email etiquette, meeting management, multicultural communication, etc.

  • Excellent communication skills to engage and teach students

  • High-Speed Internet, Modern Laptop / PC with a microphone and camera

  • Must comply with local freelance/contractor regulations

What are the terms of this freelance role?

  • $13 paid per lesson taught

  • Remote position

  • Freedom to set your own schedule

  • Access to Busuu Premium, to continue your own language learning

  • Opportunity to interact with and teach students from around the world

  • Valuable teaching experience with one of the industry’s leading companies

What happens next?

We aim to have a simple and speedy hiring process and want to make sure that we are right for you as much as the other way around. The hiring process for the freelance online role are the following 3 steps:

  1. CV application review - We will review it as quickly as possible and update on the next steps

  2. Let’s chat - Quick interview with the teacher operations manager about your experience and the role

  3. Short onboarding course

Our platform is for everyone, and so is our workplace. We pride ourselves on embracing our differences, whether they're cultural, racial, religious, or otherwise. This means each one of us comes to work knowing that we have a voice – and a safe, judgment-free zone to speak freely.

If you like the sound of that, join us. We'd love to hear what you have to say.

raw.excerpt: About FireworkJoin Firework – Where Innovation Meets Impact Firework is revolutionizing connected commerce with the world’s most advanced and largest AI-powered video commerce platform, trusted by global brands and leading retailers.
raw.description:
About Firework

Join Firework – Where Innovation Meets Impact

Firework is revolutionizing connected commerce with the world’s most advanced and largest AI-powered video commerce platform, trusted by global brands and leading retailers. We bring the energy of in-store experiences online, transforming how businesses engage, convert, and build lasting customer relationships.

At Firework, you’ll be part of a high-growth, team-centric environment where innovation thrives and collaboration fuels success. Having raised over $235m to date led by investors such as the SoftBank Vision Fund 2 and operating at a global scale, we offer unparalleled opportunities to work cross-functionally, solve complex challenges, and drive meaningful impact in the future of connected digital commerce.

If you’re curious, ambitious, and energized by big ideas, Firework is the place to grow, lead, and shape the next era of online shopping—together.

Summary

Our team is responsible for offering strategic customer success relationship management to existing clients who leverage our innovative commerce solutions to drive their business growth. We’re looking for an experienced customer success professional to join our team to nurture and grow our enterprise customers across the North America market. You are client-focused, data-driven, and excited to establish and maintain close growth-oriented partnerships with a diverse portfolio.

What you’ll be doing

  • Own a portfolio of enterprise accounts across brands and retailers, serving as the primary strategic partner and building long-term, mutually beneficial customer relationships

  • Drive customer lifetime value by identifying expansion and cross-sell opportunities, mitigating churn risk, and partnering cross-functionally to support revenue growth

  • Own the end-to-end post-sale customer journey, including onboarding, integration, adoption, utilization analysis, ROI measurement, and strategic recommendations

  • Forecast, lead, and negotiate renewals and expansion opportunities to improve retention and net revenue retention, partnering closely with Sales and Revenue Operations

  • Serve as the voice of the customer, translating customer needs and feedback into actionable insights for Product and other cross-functional teams while driving measurable adoption outcomes

  • Analyze product usage, customer behavior, and performance data to deliver proactive insights, value-based recommendations, and personalized engagement strategies

  • Lead executive business reviews and strategic check-ins that clearly demonstrate business impact, ROI, progress against goals, and opportunities for continued growth

  • Manage day-to-day customer operations, including month-end billing review, internal coordination, issue resolution, and continuous improvement of customer processes and documentation

We’ll be excited if you have

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent relevant experience

  • 7+ years of customer success, account management, or strategic relationship management experience supporting U.S. enterprise customers, ideally within B2B SaaS

  • A proven track record of managing and improving commercial KPIs such as renewal rate, expansion, net revenue retention (NRR), and churn

  • Strong commercial and product acumen, with demonstrated experience contributing to customer growth and revenue outcomes

  • Strong technical aptitude and comfort using AI, analytics, and data tools to improve customer insights, efficiency, and decision-making

  • Experience with CRM and Customer Success platforms such as Salesforce and Gainsight is preferred.

  • Exceptional attention to detail, strong prioritization skills, and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced, startup environment

  • Excellent communication, relationship-building, and consultative skills, with the ability to influence both technical and non-technical stakeholders, including senior executives

  • A balanced mix of analytical rigor, creativity, problem-solving, and customer empathy

  • Ability to work U.S. business hours

Locations

The role will be remote in India working US hours. Preference will be for Mumbai or Bangalore based candidates.

Don’t hold back

We understand some candidates may see the above and not apply because they don’t meet all the qualifications. We encourage you to apply anyway; we often find talented candidates that fit many other opportunities we have and look for potential too, not just what you did in the past. As an equal employment opportunity employer, we are a diverse team that strives for an inclusive environment for all. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws.

raw.description:
Job Title – Project Manager

Department: Technology & Engineering
Reports to: Director of Technology Implementation
Location: Remote (U.S.)
Employment Type: Full Time

Description

The Project Manager serves as the delivery lead for a portfolio of concurrent, client-facing technology projects across Acrisure Cyber Services' managed services, infrastructure, cybersecurity, business continuity, disaster recovery, and strategic implementation practices. This role is responsible for the successful execution of projects from intake through closeout, ensuring delivery within scope, budget, timeline, and quality expectations while providing an exceptional client experience.

Working closely with clients, Solutions Engineers, Deployment Engineers, Client Success teams, Procurement, and internal stakeholders, the Project Manager is accountable for project planning, communication, resource coordination, risk management, financial oversight, and change control throughout the project lifecycle. This individual serves as the primary point of accountability for project success while maintaining strong relationships with both clients and internal teams.

Project Manager Responsibilities

  • Manage a portfolio of concurrent client-facing technology projects from initiation through completion.
  • Own project scope, schedule, budget, client communication, quality, risk management, and change control throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Ensure projects meet key performance objectives related to budget adherence, delivery timelines, and client satisfaction.
  • Review project documentation including Statements of Work, engineering scope, procurement requirements, and project readiness prior to project kickoff.
  • Develop and maintain detailed project plans, schedules, milestones, dependencies, resource assignments, and project documentation.
  • Facilitate internal project kickoffs, client kickoff meetings, recurring status meetings, and project closeout sessions.
  • Provide regular project status updates, meeting recaps, executive summaries, and timely communication to clients and internal stakeholders.
  • Coordinate resources across engineering, professional services, procurement, and third-party vendors to ensure successful project execution.
  • Monitor project budgets, labor utilization, burn rates, milestone completion, and project financial performance.
  • Proactively identify project risks, issues, dependencies, and blockers while driving timely resolution and appropriate escalation.
  • Manage formal project change requests, scope modifications, and associated documentation to ensure alignment between project objectives and client expectations.
  • Coordinate project scheduling to maximize resource utilization while maintaining delivery commitments.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation within PSA and project management platforms.
  • Partner with Client Success, Technical Account Managers, and Service teams to ensure successful project transition into ongoing support.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of PMO standards, documentation, templates, processes, and project delivery methodologies.

Who You Are:

  • At least 3 years of experience managing client-facing technology projects within an MSP, IT consulting, or professional services environment.
  • Focus on customer service - We are passionate about going above and beyond to provide our customers with excellent service. We expect you to be of the same mindset.
  • Demonstrated history of job stability – We invest a lot in our employees. We are looking for candidates who want a career, not a short-term gig.
  • Accountability – You are reliable and take responsibility for the tasks assigned to you.
  • Calm under pressure with the ability to confidently manage competing priorities and challenging client situations.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent written and oral communication skills.
  • Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail with excellent documentation and project planning skills.
  • On occasion, we do require work outside of our standard business hours to accommodate client needs.

Experience/Skills Required

  • 3+ years managing multiple concurrent client-facing technology projects.
  • Experience delivering projects within managed services, IT consulting, or professional services organizations.
  • Proven experience managing project scope, budgets, schedules, risks, and client communications.
  • Experience with fixed-fee, time and materials, and managed services implementation engagements.
  • Hands-on experience using PSA platforms such as ConnectWise Manage (preferred), HaloPSA, Autotask, or similar.
  • Experience coordinating cross-functional technical resources including engineers, consultants, vendors, and third-party partners.
  • Strong understanding of project planning, resource management, budgeting, and project financial tracking.
  • Experience facilitating client meetings, executive status updates, and project governance.
  • Excellent written documentation skills including project plans, meeting summaries, status reports, and closeout documentation.
  • Strong problem-solving, organizational, and decision-making abilities.

Experience/Skills Preferred

  • PMP, CAPM, PRINCE2, CSM, or other project management certification.
  • Experience delivering managed services onboardings, infrastructure deployments, cybersecurity initiatives, business continuity, or disaster recovery projects.
  • Familiarity with ConnectWise Manage and related platforms including ConnectWise Automate, Control, Auvik, and Microsoft 365 administration.
  • Experience overseeing Microsoft 365, Azure, cloud migration, or hybrid infrastructure projects.
  • Experience working with clients in regulated industries including healthcare, financial services, legal, or manufacturing.
  • Experience developing or improving PMO processes, templates, project standards, or delivery methodologies.

About Acrisure Cyber Services:

Acrisure Cyber Services is a full-service technology partner that helps businesses attain greater success and profitability through the strategic alignment of business objectives and technology. Whether it be managed infrastructure and devices, helpdesk support, holistic best-in-class cybersecurity, strategic cyber executive services or digital transformation our flat-rate billing model provides the predictability businesses need to securely and effectively budget and scale for growth. Our value is not measured in how much time is spent implementing or supporting technology, but rather on how we’ve helped our clients leverage technology to achieve their business goals

  • You’ll work with extremely passionate, driven and experienced technical professionals. This means we recognize (and love) brilliance and hard work. We are totally focused on learning, growing, and mentoring so that everyone can prosper in their careers and add value to ACS, each other, and our clients.
  • Relationships are important to us. We provide the highest levels of customer service and strive to always exceed our clients’ expectations. You will too.
  • We love collaborating and working together as a team. You can expect company sponsored events at your location.
  • As we’re a small company that has worked hard to create processes and metrics to measure our success, you will be noticed. This means that when you’re doing well, will be noticed. It also means if you’re not working, we’re going to notice.

Benefits & Perks

We offer a comprehensive benefits program designed to support the wellbeing of our employees and their families, including:

  • Multiple medical plan options, including PPO and HSA-compatible plans
  • Dental and vision coverage
  • Employer-paid basic life and disability insurance
  • 401(k) retirement plan
  • Flexible spending and health savings account options
  • Paid time off, holidays, and additional leave programs
  • Access to wellness resources, support programs, and employee discounts
Pay Range
$90,000—$105,000 USD

Um dos maiores grupos de beleza do mundo, o Grupo Boticário é uma empresa brasileira presente em mais de 40 países. É dono das marcas O Boticário, Eudora, Quem Disse, Berenice?, Vult, O.U.i, Dr. JONES, TRUSS, e do marketplace Beleza na Web, além de atuar com produtos licenciados como Australian Gold, Bio Oil, Nuxe, e Pampers e sua divisão para o mercado B2B. Essa interação entre diferentes marcas, ativos, plataformas, rede de franqueados, representantes, distribuidores, varejistas, sellers e fornecedores formam o ecossistema de beleza do Grupo Boticário que oferece, ainda, soluções digitais de gestão de negócio para o varejo brasileiro por meio das suas marcas Mooz, Casa Magalhães e GAVB. São mais de 19 mil colaboradores diretos, com mais de 4 mil lojas em 1.780 cidades brasileiras.

Vem fazer beleza com a gente!

  • Experiência comprovada em projetos de conversão e/ou implementação de SAP ECC para SAP S/4HANA, utilizando a metodologia SAP Activate ou similar;
  • Profundo conhecimento do fluxo de processos/negócios dos ramos industriais e/ou distribuição;
  • Capacidade de ser a pessoa que impulsiona as melhorias, assumindo a responsabilidade pela resolução completa dos problemas;

  • Facilidade de se relacionar com outras áreas, fornecedores e terceiros e estabelecer relações de confiança, atuando como um consultor interno;
  • Vivência em times ágeis e colaborativos;. Capacidade de atuar com autonomia;

Lumen is the trusted network for the AI‑powered world, connecting people, data, and applications through our expansive fiber network and connected ecosystem. We enable secure, high‑performance connectivity across cloud, edge, and AI workloads for enterprises, governments, and communities.

At Lumen, you’ll work on infrastructure customers rely on today and build for what’s next, where performance, security, and resilience matter.

This is a high accountability environment where bold ideas drive real innovation for our customers, partners, and industry. The work is challenging, expectations are clear, and trust is built into how we operate. If you’re ready to take ownership, deliver meaningful impact, and help shape the future of AI‑ready connectivity, join us today.

The Role

Lumen is seeking a strategic and technically versatile Senior Lead Data Scientist to lead advanced analytics, AI-driven innovation, and decision intelligence initiatives across the Product organization. This role will serve as a bridge between traditional analytics, modern data science, and emerging AI technologies, transforming complex data into actionable insights, predictive models, and intelligent solutions that improve business outcomes.

The ideal candidate combines deep analytical expertise with practical experience developing quantitative analytics models, automating workflows, and leveraging AI platforms to solve real-world business challenges. As the business continues to evolve, this individual will play a key role in defining new performance measurements, developing next-generation KPI frameworks, and enabling data-driven decision making through a combination of code-based and no-code solutions.

This is a highly visible individual contributor role requiring strong business acumen, technical depth, and cross-functional leadership.

Location

This is a remote opportunity open to candidates located anywhere in the U.S.

The Main Responsibilities

  • Lead Strategic Analytics: Partner with Product, Finance, Engineering, and Executive leaders to identify opportunities for advanced analytics, AI, and data-driven decision making.
  • Develop KPI & Measurement Frameworks: Define and evolve performance metrics that measure business value, operational efficiency, customer outcomes, and product success.
  • Drive Advanced Analytics: Build predictive models, forecasts, segmentation strategies, and optimization frameworks to uncover insights, risks, and growth opportunities.
  • Enable AI & Automation: Evaluate and implement AI-powered solutions, intelligent workflows, and automation capabilities that improve productivity and decision quality.
  • Champion Innovation & Experimentation: Lead proof-of-concepts and rapid testing of emerging technologies to validate business impact and accelerate adoption.
  • Deliver Data-Driven Insights: Translate complex analyses into actionable recommendations, dashboards, and executive-level narratives.
  • Automate Reporting & Processes: Design scalable analytics solutions, automated reporting, and workflow automation to improve efficiency and insight delivery.
  • Leverage Modern Technology Platforms: Utilize Python, SQL, AI-assisted development tools, Power Platform, and low-code/no-code solutions to accelerate outcomes.
  • Collaborate Across Functions: Work closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, Sales, Customer Success, and Data teams to align on priorities, methodologies, and business objectives.
  • Provide Thought Leadership: Promote analytics, AI literacy, experimentation, and data-driven decision making while mentoring stakeholders and team members on best practices.

  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
  • 8+ years of experience in analytics, data science, business intelligence, or related disciplines.

  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python.
  • Experience developing predictive models, forecasting techniques, statistical analyses, and data-driven decision frameworks.
  • Experience creating KPI frameworks, business performance measurements, and executive reporting solutions.
  • Strong experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Experience working with both structured and unstructured data sources.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to convey complex technical concepts to non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working with AI and machine learning platforms, including large language models and generative AI technologies.
  • Experience developing AI-enabled workflows, intelligent automation solutions, or agent-based capabilities.

Job Description

Job Title: Senior Consultant, Modern Security
Job Location: Remote: Alberta or British Columbia

Compensation

The position is a full time, salaried position. Compensation is expected to be between $100,000.00 - $140,000.00 commensurate with skills, experience, and abilities.

Company Profile

IX Solutions is a trusted IT partner, connecting people with technology tailored to meet their business needs. We help our clients effectively leverage modern technology and embrace digital transformation to achieve their critical business outcomes.

Ultimately, we’re here to inspire innovation — for our customers and our people. For us, that means inviting ambitious individuals to the table — those who are primed to push the envelope — and fostering an imaginative environment for them to thrive. Why? Because we believe when you bring visionaries together with a genuine drive to do better and give them transformative technology as the toolkit, the possibilities and potential for your business become boundless.

Position Summary

This role is ideal for an individual passionate about leveraging technology to drive customer success and improved security within a collaborative, customer-centric culture at IX Solutions. The Senior Consultant, Modern Security will deliver proactive and reactive security and endpoint management services to clients, ensuring exceptional service delivery and fostering strong client relationships. This role involves remote and onsite implementations and support.

The Senior Consultant, Modern Security collaborates with client stakeholders, other technical consultants, Client Leads and Account Executives to deliver proposed technical solutions and services the “IX Solutions” way. The position works to improve consistency in security alignment, security services deployments, application patching, and helping our clients adopt a “cloud-first” model.

The position reports to the Manager, Service Delivery. The position works 40 hours per week, with business hours being 8:00am to 5:00pm MT/PT, Monday to Friday. There are occasional requirements for after-hours work including time sensitive client requests and project work. Balancing multiple priorities with deadlines is a requirement.

IX Solutions is committed to helping employees grow and develop within the organization, so the responsibilities below may be adjusted periodically to align with employee goals or aptitudes while supporting overall business objectives.

Is This Position A Fit For You?

This position is a fit for you if you:
  • Are a security enthusiast who enjoys challenges.
  • Take a security first approach when assessing a client environment.
  • Possess technical skills with expertise in Microsoft 365 and Azure.
  • Care about security best practices.
  • Take ownership of your work and demonstrate a strong commitment to follow through on your tasks.
  • Are committed to client success and security.
  • Can demonstrate a calm demeanor during stressful situations.
  • Excel in translating business requirements into technical needs.
  • Excel in effectively conveying technical information to stakeholders in a non-technical manner.
  • Are skilled at building rapport and enjoy supporting partnerships.
  • Thrive on building and maintaining client partnerships.
  • Are looking for mentorship and opportunities to grow. This is the place for you.

What You’ll Do Here

  • Provide consulting and technical guidance, coaching, and support to team members and clients.
  • Serve as the subject matter expert for technologies within the Security team's technical purview.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to meet client requirements and project objectives.
  • Deliver IT support, project planning (including the development of statements of work & work breakdown structures), and technical delivery of managed services to a broad range of clients.
  • Plan and execute transition of endpoint management from traditional solutions such as SCCM to Intune including Autopilot, Windows Update for Business, and Entra-joined workstations.
  • Plan and deploy Microsoft security products such as Defender, Sentinel, and Entra ID to protect against cyber threats, ensuring compliance with industry regulations and best practices.
  • Conduct Conditional Access and Privileged Identity Management review workshops with clients.
  • Assist or lead projects from initial assessment, solutioning, design, and implementation.
  • Conduct security assessments and provide recommendations.
  • Provide training and guidance to clients on information security standards, policies, and best practices within the Microsoft ecosystem.
  • Deliver recurring security services and monthly reporting to clients.
  • Maintain documentation related to IXS security practices, client support and delivery processes.
  • Act as an escalation point for other teams, including participating in incident response and resolutions.
  • Onsite support, as required.

What You Bring

Mindset & Attributes

  • Collaborative with a humble and proactive approach to problem solving.
  • Comfort with balancing speed, precision, and creativity in a dynamic environment.
  • Able to maintain relationships with various people in the organization, servicing the needs of multiple teams and managing conflict.
  • Possess a consultative mindset—you thrive on collaboration and building consensus.
  • Passion for continuous learning in technical, consultative, and personal skills.

Qualifications/Expertise

  • Minimum 5 years of IT consulting experience (or customer service-centric experience).
  • Experience with Intune best practices, such as Autopilot, device enrollment, endpoint security, application packaging and update management.
  • Experience with the Microsoft Defender suite.
  • Experience with Microsoft Sentinel, both deployment and threat hunting.
  • Experience with Microsoft Conditional Access, Privileged Identity Management, Identity Protection and MFA, both deployment and best practices.
  • Experience with Azure monitoring tools, such as Log Analytics, Logic Apps and Azure Monitor. Knowledge of KQL is an asset.
  • Experience designing and implementing Role Based Access Control models.
  • Experience with Apple Business Manager, Patch My PC, cloud printing (Printix, Universal Print), and security awareness training.
  • Practical and technical experience with Mobile Device Management or Mobile Application Management.
  • Working knowledge of Enterprise Apps & SAML SSO Functionality.
  • Working knowledge of Entra Connect Sync and Entra Cloud Sync.
  • Understanding of least privilege and zero trust concepts.
  • Understanding of networking concepts.
  • Previous focus on continuing education and training is a must.

Certifications and Learning (achieved or willing to work towards)

  • SC-500 (AZ-500): Cloud and AI Security Engineer Associate.
  • SC-100: Microsoft Certified: Cybersecurity Architect Expert.
  • SC-200: Microsoft Certified: Security Operations Analyst Associate.
  • SC-300: Microsoft Certified: Identity and Access Administrator Associate.
  • MD-102: Microsoft 365 Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate.
  • MS-102: Microsoft 365 Certified: Administrator Expert.
  • AZ-104: Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate.
  • AZ-802 (800/801): Microsoft Certified: Windows Server Administrator Associate.

Accountabilities, Tasks and Duties

Client Relationships

  • Understand and interpret customer needs so we can provide excellent service levels.
  • Develop strong and lasting customer relationships with key clients.
  • Assist with the development of proposals and pre-sales exercises, including the presentation of technologies and solution proposals to clients and prospective clients.
  • Clearly and regularly communicate with Client Experience Team and Account Executives.
  • Work independently and with the Project Delivery Team.
  • Promptly respond to technical escalations from Client Experience team and other technical teams.
  • Pass certification exams and complete training as appropriate to demonstrate skillset to clients and foster strong vendor relationships.
  • Stay current with the latest technology trends, vulnerabilities and releases.
  • Maintain team-owned best practices and standards and communicate them to other teams.
  • Develop, document, and maintain processes and procedures related to project delivery & managed services.

Team

  • Communicate in an open, helpful manner and build relationships across the organization.
  • Ability to work with a range of technical staff and cross-functional teams to develop joint solutions.
  • Foster a collaborative work environment and culture.
  • Challenge the status quo.
  • Take personal accountability and provide end-to-end ownership of a solution or obstacle.
  • Be willing to put in the effort when it really counts.
  • Create accurate and effective documentation and develop standards.
  • Engage with team and demonstrate commitment to alignment with the organizational mission and corporate values.
  • Other duties as required, such as the timely completion of expense reports and timesheets.
  • Ability to travel occasionally for business purposes.

Requirements

  • Must be legally permitted to work in Canada.
  • Hold a valid Driver’s License and vehicle.
  • Proficient English (written/verbal) communication in a business setting.
  • Willingness to travel as needed to meet with clients.

IX Solutions is pleased to offer remote work opportunities for our employees, however we do require employees to reside in Alberta or British Columbia, Canada.
